answer: Farming becomes an island bet on surviving 93 epochs of grading, and every orchard settlement recomputes the dawn schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 10 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 93 epochs rather than arriving at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
